tracks.name: Weapon camos
tracks.description: Military, Special, and Completionist camos. One grind per weapon, shared by Multiplayer, DMZ, and (from Season 1) Warzone.

tiers.name: Military and Special
tiers.description: Eight Military camos unlocked by weapon level and three Special camos with mode-aware challenges. All eleven must be done before Gold opens on that weapon.

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.description: Opens on a weapon once all eight Military and three Special camos are unlocked on it.

tiers.name: Platinum
tiers.description: Opens on a weapon once every weapon in that class has Gold. The challenge is unique per weapon class.

tiers.name: Harmonic Break
tiers.description: Opens once Platinum is done on 33 weapons. The challenge is unique per weapon class.

tiers.name: Divergence
tiers.description: Awarded automatically for completing 33 Harmonic Break challenges. Unlocks the Mastery 1 challenges.

tracks.name: Multiplayer Mastery
tracks.description: Mercurial Drift, Polyatomic Reforged, Orion Reforged. Opens after Divergence.

tiers.name: Polyatomic Reforged
tiers.description: Multiplayer Mastery 2. Opens after Mercurial Drift.

tiers.name: Orion Reforged
tiers.description: Multiplayer Mastery 3. Opens after Polyatomic Reforged.

tracks.name: DMZ Mastery
tracks.description: Chiral, Ripple Tide, Helio. Opens after Divergence.

tiers.name: Helio
tiers.description: DMZ Mastery 3. Opens after Ripple Tide.

tracks.name: Warzone Mastery
tracks.description: Parallax, Damascus Reforged, Empyros. Requirements are classified until Season 1.

tiers.name: Parallax
tiers.description: Warzone Mastery 1. Opens after Divergence. Requirement classified until Season 1.

tiers.name: Empyros
tiers.description: Warzone Mastery 3. Opens after Damascus Reforged.

tracks.name: Weapon Prestige
tracks.description: Pyroclast and its facets. Per weapon, after the weapon reaches max level.

tiers.name: Pyroclast
tiers.description: Enter Weapon Prestige 1 on this weapon (available at max weapon level).

tiers.name: Pyroclast Terminus
tiers.description: Reach Weapon Prestige 1 max level on this weapon.

tiers.name: Pyroclast Scatter
tiers.description: Reach Weapon Prestige Master level 150 on this weapon.

tiers.name: Pyroclast Cascade
tiers.description: Reach Weapon Prestige Master level 250 on this weapon.
